diagnosis: C creates ICE beneath ordinary low boots at step 171. When the hero leaves the ice at step 196, hack.c:slippery_ice_fumbling checks whether the worn boots are snow boots with objdescr_is(uarmf, "snow boots"). The JavaScript function makes the same call, but js/hack.js does not import objdescr_is from o_init.js, so movement stops with ReferenceError before the source RNG draw and fumbling state update.

source.branch: While standing on ice without levitation, a snow-boots check suppresses slipping; otherwise C may set timed fumbling. Leaving ice clears the FROMOUTSIDE source.
dependencies: o_init.c:objdescr_is compares the unidentified object description to the supplied text
source.cBehavior: C calls objdescr_is on the worn boots before the cold-resistance and movement checks. With non-snow boots, it continues through the source movement branch and may consume rn2(2).
source.jsBeforeFix: js/hack.js calls objdescr_is but imports only init_objects from o_init.js.

fix: Import the existing objdescr_is helper from o_init.js into js/hack.js; keep the snow-boots check and following source order unchanged.
